Question 15
?

The projection of the intersection between the elliptic paraboloid 5(x+2)2+3(y+3)2=z and the plane z=2 onto the xy-plane is an ellipse. Find the center of this ellipse.

a
(2,−3) in the xy-plane
b
(2,3) in the xy-plane
c
(0,0) in the xy-plane
d
(−2,−3) in the xy-plane
e
(−2,3) in the xy-plane
Submit
